segments.text: yourself this. Is your laboratory actually safe at 11 p.m. on a Friday, when a lone researcher
segments.zh: 你自己：在周五晚上 11 点，当一名独自工作的研究人员

segments.text: is tired, under pressure, and absolutely nobody is watching? That, that is the true measure of
segments.zh: 疲惫不堪、承受着压力，而且根本没有人在看着的时候，你们的实验室真的安全吗？那，那才是衡量

segments.text: your safety culture. We've really just scratched the surface today, but I hope this challenges
segments.zh: 你们安全文化的真正标准。今天我们真的只是触及了皮毛，但我希望这能激励

segments.text: you to look way beyond the paperwork and evaluate the real operating system running your science.
segments.zh: 你超越文书工作，去评估真正驱动你们科研的那套操作系统。

segments.text: Thanks so much for joining me for this explainer.
segments.zh: 非常感谢你收看本期讲解。
